role: Bootstrap nine foundational pre-linguistic primitive symbol nodes into the knowledge graph.
detail: Seeds nine PrimitiveSymbolNode nodes (Self_Other, Entity, Relation, State, Time, Change, Cause, Valence, Means) that form the structural base for all symbolic reasoning. Exports bootstrap_primitives() async function that idempotently creates primitives if they don't exist, checking via persistence.get_primitive_symbol() before save. Returns PrimitiveBootstrapResult dataclass with created/existing/total counts. Each primitive has a node_id (e.g., 'primitive:self_other'), descriptive name, and multi-sentence description explaining its role in the symbolic architecture (e.g., Means enables language grounding by representing symbol-to-symbol mappings). Module is safe to call multiple times; subsequent calls return created=0 and existing=9.
gotchas: None observed; well-structured idempotent code with clear contract. Depends on persistence backend implementing get_primitive_symbol() and save_primitive_symbol() methods (referenced in docstring as added in Phase 1).
